test_df["text"] = test_df.apply(combine_text, axis=1)

encoder.fit(meta_features)

test_meta = encoder.transform(test_df[["category", "host"]]).toarray()
meta_feature_size = train_meta.shape[1]

# Prepare text inputs
train_texts = train_df.apply(

test_texts = test_df.apply(

target_cols = train_df.columns[11:41].tolist()

(

) = train_test_split(train_texts, train_meta, targets, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

# Tokenization setup
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-base")


class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, meta_features, targets=None):
        self.texts = texts
        self.meta_features = meta_features
        self.targets = targets

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        inputs = tokenizer(
            text,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=512,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        inputs = {k: v.squeeze(0) for k, v in inputs.items()}
        meta = torch.FloatTensor(self.meta_features[idx])
        if self.targets is not None:
            return inputs, meta, torch.FloatTensor(self.targets[idx])
        return inputs, meta


# Create dataloaders

class QARegressor(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, meta_feature_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.deberta = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-base")
        self.dropout = torch.nn.Dropout(0.2)
        self.meta_proj = torch.nn.Linear(meta_feature_size, 768)
        self.head = torch.nn.Linear(768 * 2, 30)
        self.sigmoid = torch.nn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, meta_features):
        outputs = self.deberta(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        pooled = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        meta_projected = self.meta_proj(meta_features)
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, meta_projected], dim=1)
        return self.sigmoid(self.head(self.dropout(combined)))


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = QARegressor(meta_feature_size).to(device)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-5, weight_decay=0.01)

        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)

    scores = [spearmanr(truths[:, i], preds[:, i]).correlation for i in range(30)]
    mean_score = np.nanmean(scores)

        self.meta_features = meta_features
        self.targets = targets

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        inputs = tokenizer(
            text,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=512,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        inputs = {k: v.squeeze(0) for k, v in inputs.items()}
        meta = torch.FloatTensor(self.meta_features[idx])
        if self.targets is not None:
            return inputs, meta, torch.FloatTensor(self.targets[idx])
        return inputs, meta

        self.meta_proj = torch.nn.Linear(meta_feature_size, 768)
        self.head = torch.nn.Linear(768 * 2, 30)

        outputs = self.deberta(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        pooled = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        meta_projected = self.meta_proj(meta_features)
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, meta_projected], dim=1)
        return self.sigmoid(self.head(self.dropout(combined)))

# Load data

# Prepare meta features
encoder = OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore")
meta_features = pd.concat(
    [train_df[["category", "host"]], test_df[["category", "host"]]], axis=0
)
encoder.fit(meta_features)
train_meta = encoder.transform(train_df[["category", "host"]]).toarray()
test_meta = encoder.transform(test_df[["category", "host"]]).toarray()
meta_feature_size = train_meta.shape[1]

# Prepare text inputs with improved segment separation
train_texts = train_df.apply(
    lambda x: f"{x['question_title']} </s> {x['question_body']} </s> {x['answer']}",
    axis=1,
).tolist()
test_texts = test_df.apply(
    lambda x: f"{x['question_title']} </s> {x['question_body']} </s> {x['answer']}",
    axis=1,
).tolist()

# Extract targets
target_cols = train_df.columns[11:41].tolist()
targets = train_df[target_cols].values

# Train-validation split
(
    train_texts,
    val_texts,
    train_meta_split,
    val_meta_split,
    train_targets,
    val_targets,
) = train_test_split(train_texts, train_meta, targets, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

# Tokenization setup
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-base")


class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, meta_features, targets=None):
        self.texts = texts
        self.meta_features = meta_features
        self.targets = targets

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        inputs = tokenizer(
            text,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=512,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        inputs = {k: v.squeeze(0) for k, v in inputs.items()}
        meta = torch.FloatTensor(self.meta_features[idx])
        if self.targets is not None:
            return inputs, meta, torch.FloatTensor(self.targets[idx])
        return inputs, meta


# Create dataloaders with larger batch size
train_dataset = QADataset(train_texts, train_meta_split, train_targets)
val_dataset = QADataset(val_texts, val_meta_split, val_targets)
test_dataset = QADataset(test_texts, test_meta)

train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=16, shuffle=True, num_workers=8)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=16, num_workers=8)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=16, num_workers=8)


class QARegressor(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, meta_feature_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.deberta = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-base")
        self.dropout = torch.nn.Dropout(0.3)

        # Gated fusion components
        self.meta_gate = torch.nn.Sequential(
            torch.nn.Linear(meta_feature_size, 768),
            torch.nn.ReLU(),
            torch.nn.Linear(768, 768),
            torch.nn.Sigmoid(),
        )
        self.meta_proj = torch.nn.Linear(meta_feature_size, 768)

        # Final layers
        self.head = torch.nn.Sequential(
            torch.nn.Linear(768 * 2, 1024), torch.nn.GELU(), torch.nn.Linear(1024, 30)
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, meta_features):
        outputs = self.deberta(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        pooled = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]

        # Process meta features
        meta_proj = self.meta_proj(meta_features)
        gate = self.meta_gate(meta_features)

        # Gated fusion
        gated_text = pooled * gate
        combined = torch.cat([gated_text, meta_proj], dim=1)

        return self.head(self.dropout(combined))


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = QARegressor(meta_feature_size).to(device)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=3e-5, weight_decay=0.01)
criterion = torch.nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=5)

# Training loop with early stopping
best_score = -1
patience = 2
current_patience = 0

for epoch in range(10):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0
    for batch in train_loader:
        inputs, meta, targets = batch
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in inputs.items()}
        meta, targets = meta.to(device), targets.to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(inputs["input_ids"], inputs["attention_mask"], meta)
        loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()

    scheduler.step()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    preds, truths = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            inputs, meta, targets = batch
            inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in inputs.items()}
            meta = meta.to(device)
            outputs = model(inputs["input_ids"], inputs["attention_mask"], meta)
            preds.append(torch.sigmoid(outputs).cpu())
            truths.append(targets.cpu())

    preds = torch.cat(preds).numpy()
    truths = torch.cat(truths).numpy()
    scores = [spearmanr(truths[:, i], preds[:, i]).correlation for i in range(30)]
    mean_score = np.nanmean(scores)
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Loss={total_loss/len(train_loader):.4f}, Val Score={mean_score:.4f}"
    )

    # Early stopping
    if mean_score > best_score:
        best_score = mean_score
        current_patience = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pt")
    else:
        current_patience += 1
        if current_patience >= patience:
            print("Early stopping triggered")
            break

# Load best model and predict
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pt"))
model.eval()
test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:
        inputs, meta = batch
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in inputs.items()}
        meta = meta.to(device)
        outputs = model(inputs["input_ids"], inputs["attention_mask"], meta)
        test_preds.append(torch.sigmoid(outputs).cpu().numpy())

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"qa_id": test_df.qa_id})
submission = pd.concat(
    [submission, pd.DataFrame(np.concatenate(test_preds), columns=target_cols)], axis=1
)

        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, emb_dim)

            nn.Linear(512, 256),

        ]
        cat_emb = self.cat_emb(cat)
        host_emb = self.host_emb(host)
        combined = torch.cat([q_out, a_out, cat_emb, host_emb], dim=1)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.head(combined))

test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

# Prepare meta features
encoder = OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore")
meta_features = pd.concat(
    [train_df[["category", "host"]], test_df[["category", "host"]]], axis=0
)
encoder.fit(meta_features)
train_meta = encoder.transform(train_df[["category", "host"]]).toarray()
test_meta = encoder.transform(test_df[["category", "host"]]).toarray()
meta_feature_size = train_meta.shape[1]

# Prepare text inputs with improved segment separation
train_texts = train_df.apply(
    lambda x: f"{x['question_title']} </s> {x['question_body']} </s> {x['answer']}",
    axis=1,
).tolist()
test_texts = test_df.apply(
    lambda x: f"{x['question_title']} </s> {x['question_body']} </s> {x['answer']}",
    axis=1,
).tolist()

# Extract targets
target_cols = train_df.columns[11:41].tolist()
targets = train_df[target_cols].values

# Train-validation split
(
    train_texts,
    val_texts,
    train_meta_split,
    val_meta_split,
    train_targets,
    val_targets,
) = train_test_split(train_texts, train_meta, targets, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

# Tokenization setup
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-base")


class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, meta_features, targets=None):
        self.texts = texts
        self.meta_features = meta_features
        self.targets = targets

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        inputs = tokenizer(
            text,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=512,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        inputs = {k: v.squeeze(0) for k, v in inputs.items()}
        meta = torch.FloatTensor(self.meta_features[idx])
        if self.targets is not None:
            return inputs, meta, torch.FloatTensor(self.targets[idx])
        return inputs, meta


# Create dataloaders with larger batch size
train_dataset = QADataset(train_texts, train_meta_split, train_targets)
val_dataset = QADataset(val_texts, val_meta_split, val_targets)
test_dataset = QADataset(test_texts, test_meta)

train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=16, shuffle=True, num_workers=8)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=16, num_workers=8)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=16, num_workers=8)


class QARegressor(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, meta_feature_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.deberta = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-base")
        self.dropout = torch.nn.Dropout(0.3)

        # Gated fusion components
        self.meta_gate = torch.nn.Sequential(
            torch.nn.Linear(meta_feature_size, 768),
            torch.nn.ReLU(),
            torch.nn.Linear(768, 768),
            torch.nn.Sigmoid(),
        )
        self.meta_proj = torch.nn.Linear(meta_feature_size, 768)

        # Final layers
        self.head = torch.nn.Sequential(
            torch.nn.Linear(768 * 2, 1024), torch.nn.GELU(), torch.nn.Linear(1024, 30)
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, meta_features):
        outputs = self.deberta(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        pooled = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]

        # Process meta features
        meta_proj = self.meta_proj(meta_features)
        gate = self.meta_gate(meta_features)

        # Gated fusion
        gated_text = pooled * gate
        combined = torch.cat([gated_text, meta_proj], dim=1)

        return self.head(self.dropout(combined))


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = QARegressor(meta_feature_size).to(device)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=3e-5, weight_decay=0.01)
criterion = torch.nn.MSELoss()  # Changed to MSE loss
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=5)

# Training loop with early stopping
best_score = -1
patience = 2
current_patience = 0

for epoch in range(10):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0
    for batch in train_loader:
        inputs, meta, targets = batch
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in inputs.items()}
        meta, targets = meta.to(device), targets.to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(inputs["input_ids"], inputs["attention_mask"], meta)
        preds = torch.sigmoid(outputs)  # Apply sigmoid before loss calculation
        loss = criterion(preds, targets)
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()

    scheduler.step()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    preds, truths = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            inputs, meta, targets = batch
            inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in inputs.items()}
            meta = meta.to(device)
            outputs = model(inputs["input_ids"], inputs["attention_mask"], meta)
            preds.append(torch.sigmoid(outputs).cpu())
            truths.append(targets.cpu())

    preds = torch.cat(preds).numpy()
    truths = torch.cat(truths).numpy()
    scores = [spearmanr(truths[:, i], preds[:, i]).correlation for i in range(30)]
    mean_score = np.nanmean(scores)
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Loss={total_loss/len(train_loader):.4f}, Val Score={mean_score:.4f}"
    )

    # Early stopping
    if mean_score > best_score:
        best_score = mean_score
        current_patience = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pt")
    else:
        current_patience += 1
        if current_patience >= patience:
            print("Early stopping triggered")
            break

# Load best model and predict
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pt"))
model.eval()
test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:
        inputs, meta = batch
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in inputs.items()}
        meta = meta.to(device)
        outputs = model(inputs["input_ids"], inputs["attention_mask"], meta)
        test_preds.append(torch.sigmoid(outputs).cpu().numpy())

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"qa_id": test_df.qa_id})
submission = pd.concat(
    [submission, pd.DataFrame(np.concatenate(test_preds), columns=target_cols)], axis=1
)
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Final Validation Score: {best_score:.4f}")

# Dataset class with test mode support
class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, tokenizer, max_len=256, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_len = max_len
        self.is_test = is_test

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        question = row["question_title"] + " " + row["question_body"]
        answer = row["answer"]

        q_enc = self.tokenizer(
            question,
            max_length=self.max_len,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        a_enc = self.tokenizer(
            answer,
            max_length=self.max_len,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            return_tensors="pt",
        )

        item = {
            "q_ids": q_enc["input_ids"].squeeze(),
            "q_mask": q_enc["attention_mask"].squeeze(),
            "a_ids": a_enc["input_ids"].squeeze(),
            "a_mask": a_enc["attention_mask"].squeeze(),
            "cat": torch.tensor(row["category_enc"], dtype=torch.long),
            "host": torch.tensor(row["host_enc"], dtype=torch.long),
        }

        if not self.is_test:
            item["targets"] = torch.tensor(row[target_cols], dtype=torch.float)

        return item


# Model remains unchanged
class SiameseQA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name, num_cats, num_hosts, emb_dim=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.bert = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, emb_dim)
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(num_hosts, emb_dim)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.bert.config.hidden_size * 2 + emb_dim * 2, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(256, 30),
        )

    def forward(self, q_ids, q_mask, a_ids, a_mask, cat, host):
        q_out = self.bert(input_ids=q_ids, attention_mask=q_mask).last_hidden_state[
            :, 0, :
        ]
        a_out = self.bert(input_ids=a_ids, attention_mask=a_mask).last_hidden_state[
            :, 0, :
        ]
        cat_emb = self.cat_emb(cat)
        host_emb = self.host_emb(host)
        combined = torch.cat([q_out, a_out, cat_emb, host_emb], dim=1)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.head(combined))


# Training setup
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model_name = "roberta-base"
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)

criterion = nn.MSELoss()
scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
    optimizer, num_warmup_steps=0, num_training_steps=len(train_loader) * 3
)

# Training loop
best_score = 0
for epoch in range(3):
    model.train()
    for batch in train_loader:
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        inputs = {
            "q_ids": batch["q_ids"].to(device),
            "q_mask": batch["q_mask"].to(device),
            "a_ids": batch["a_ids"].to(device),
            "a_mask": batch["a_mask"].to(device),
            "cat": batch["cat"].to(device),
            "host": batch["host"].to(device),
        }
        preds = model(**inputs)
        loss = criterion(preds, batch["targets"].to(device))
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    all_preds, all_targets = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            inputs = {
                "q_ids": batch["q_ids"].to(device),
                "q_mask": batch["q_mask"].to(device),
                "a_ids": batch["a_ids"].to(device),
                "a_mask": batch["a_mask"].to(device),
                "cat": batch["cat"].to(device),
                "host": batch["host"].to(device),
            }
            preds = model(**inputs).cpu().numpy()
            targets = batch["targets"].numpy()
            all_preds.append(preds)

    all_preds = np.concatenate(all_preds)
    all_targets = np.concatenate(all_targets)
    scores = []
    for i in range(30):
        scores.append(spearmanr(all_preds[:, i], all_targets[:, i]).correlation)
    mean_score = np.nanmean(scores)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1} Validation Score: {mean_score:.4f}")
    if mean_score > best_score:
        best_score = mean_score
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")

# Generate predictions
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pt"))
model.eval()
test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import torch
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel, AdamW
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
import torch.nn as nn
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# Configuration
MODEL_NAME = "roberta-large"
MAX_LEN = 512
BATCH_SIZE = 16
EPOCHS = 10
PATIENCE = 2

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
target_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in test_df.columns]

# Prepare text inputs
train_df["question_text"] = (
    train_df["question_title"].fillna("") + " " + train_df["question_body"].fillna("")
)
train_df["answer_text"] = train_df["answer"].fillna("")
test_df["question_text"] = (
    test_df["question_title"].fillna("") + " " + test_df["question_body"].fillna("")
)
test_df["answer_text"] = test_df["answer"].fillna("")

# Encode categorical features
combined_cats = pd.concat([train_df["category"], test_df["category"]])
category_encoder = LabelEncoder().fit(combined_cats)
train_df["category_encoded"] = category_encoder.transform(train_df["category"])
test_df["category_encoded"] = category_encoder.transform(test_df["category"])

combined_hosts = pd.concat([train_df["host"], test_df["host"]])
host_encoder = LabelEncoder().fit(combined_hosts)
train_df["host_encoded"] = host_encoder.transform(train_df["host"])
test_df["host_encoded"] = host_encoder.transform(test_df["host"])

# Train-validation split
train_df, val_df = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

# Tokenization
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)


class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, questions, answers, categories, hosts, targets=None):
        self.questions = questions
        self.answers = answers
        self.categories = categories
        self.hosts = hosts
        self.targets = targets

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.questions)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        encoding = tokenizer(
            text=str(self.questions[idx]),
            text_pair=str(self.answers[idx]),
            add_special_tokens=True,
            max_length=MAX_LEN,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )

        item = {
            "input_ids": encoding["input_ids"].squeeze(),
            "attention_mask": encoding["attention_mask"].squeeze(),
            "category": torch.tensor(self.categories[idx], dtype=torch.long),
            "host": torch.tensor(self.hosts[idx], dtype=torch.long),
        }

        if self.targets is not None:
            item["targets"] = torch.tensor(self.targets[idx], dtype=torch.float)
        return item


# Create datasets and loaders
train_dataset = QADataset(
    train_df["question_text"].values,
    train_df["answer_text"].values,
    train_df["category_encoded"].values,
    train_df["host_encoded"].values,
    train_df[target_cols].values,
)
val_dataset = QADataset(
    val_df["question_text"].values,
    val_df["answer_text"].values,
    val_df["category_encoded"].values,
    val_df["host_encoded"].values,
    val_df[target_cols].values,
)
test_dataset = QADataset(
    test_df["question_text"].values,
    test_df["answer_text"].values,
    test_df["category_encoded"].values,
    test_df["host_encoded"].values,
)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=4)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=4)


class QAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_cats, num_hosts):
        super().__init__()
        self.transformer = AutoModel.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 64)
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(num_hosts, 64)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.transformer.config.hidden_size + 128, 512),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(256, 30),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, category, host):
        outputs = self.transformer(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        cls_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0]
        cat_emb = self.cat_emb(category)
        host_emb = self.host_emb(host)
        combined = torch.cat([cls_output, cat_emb, host_emb], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = QAModel(len(category_encoder.classes_), len(host_encoder.classes_)).to(device)
optimizer = AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-5, weight_decay=0.01)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()

# Training loop with early stopping
best_score = 0
epochs_no_improve = 0
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for batch in train_loader:
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items() if k != "targets"}
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        loss = criterion(outputs, batch["targets"].to(device))
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_preds, val_targets = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items() if k != "targets"}
            preds = model(**inputs).cpu().numpy()
            val_preds.append(preds)
            val_targets.append(batch["targets"].numpy())

    val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds)
    val_targets = np.concatenate(val_targets)
    correlations = []
    for i in range(30):
        corr = spearmanr(val_preds[:, i], val_targets[:, i]).correlation
        correlations.append(0 if np.isnan(corr) else corr)
    mean_corr = np.mean(correlations)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1} Validation Spearman: {mean_corr:.4f}")

    if mean_corr > best_score:
        best_score = mean_corr
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

# Generate predictions
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pt"))
model.eval()
test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items()}
        preds = model(**inputs).cpu().numpy()
        test_preds.append(preds)

submission = pd.DataFrame(np.concatenate(test_preds), columns=target_cols)
submission.insert(0, "qa_id", test_df["qa_id"].values)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Final Validation Score: {best_score:.4f}")

train_texts = train_df.apply(

class QADataset(Dataset):

# Create dataloaders

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import torch
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel, AdamW
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
import torch.nn as nn
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# Configuration
MODEL_NAME = "roberta-large"
MAX_LEN = 512
BATCH_SIZE = 16
EPOCHS = 10
PATIENCE = 2

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
target_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in test_df.columns]

# Prepare text inputs
train_df["question_text"] = (
    train_df["question_title"].fillna("") + " " + train_df["question_body"].fillna("")
)
train_df["answer_text"] = train_df["answer"].fillna("")
test_df["question_text"] = (
    test_df["question_title"].fillna("") + " " + test_df["question_body"].fillna("")
)
test_df["answer_text"] = test_df["answer"].fillna("")

# Encode categorical features
combined_cats = pd.concat([train_df["category"], test_df["category"]])
category_encoder = LabelEncoder().fit(combined_cats)
train_df["category_encoded"] = category_encoder.transform(train_df["category"])
test_df["category_encoded"] = category_encoder.transform(test_df["category"])

combined_hosts = pd.concat([train_df["host"], test_df["host"]])
host_encoder = LabelEncoder().fit(combined_hosts)
train_df["host_encoded"] = host_encoder.transform(train_df["host"])
test_df["host_encoded"] = host_encoder.transform(test_df["host"])

# Train-validation split
train_df, val_df = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

# Tokenization
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)


class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, questions, answers, categories, hosts, targets=None):
        self.questions = questions
        self.answers = answers
        self.categories = categories
        self.hosts = hosts
        self.targets = targets

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.questions)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        encoding = tokenizer(
            text=str(self.questions[idx]),
            text_pair=str(self.answers[idx]),
            add_special_tokens=True,
            max_length=MAX_LEN,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )

        item = {
            "input_ids": encoding["input_ids"].squeeze(),
            "attention_mask": encoding["attention_mask"].squeeze(),
            "category": torch.tensor(self.categories[idx], dtype=torch.long),
            "host": torch.tensor(self.hosts[idx], dtype=torch.long),
        }

        if self.targets is not None:
            item["targets"] = torch.tensor(self.targets[idx], dtype=torch.float)
        return item


train_dataset = QADataset(
    train_df["question_text"].values,
    train_df["answer_text"].values,
    train_df["category_encoded"].values,
    train_df["host_encoded"].values,
    train_df[target_cols].values,
)
val_dataset = QADataset(
    val_df["question_text"].values,
    val_df["answer_text"].values,
    val_df["category_encoded"].values,
    val_df["host_encoded"].values,
    val_df[target_cols].values,
)
test_dataset = QADataset(
    test_df["question_text"].values,
    test_df["answer_text"].values,
    test_df["category_encoded"].values,
    test_df["host_encoded"].values,
)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=4)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=4)


class QAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_cats, num_hosts):
        super().__init__()
        self.transformer = AutoModel.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 16)
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(num_hosts, 16)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.transformer.config.hidden_size + 32, 512),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(256, 30),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, category, host):
        outputs = self.transformer(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        cls_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0]
        cat_emb = self.cat_emb(category)
        host_emb = self.host_emb(host)
        combined = torch.cat([cls_output, cat_emb, host_emb], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = QAModel(len(category_encoder.classes_), len(host_encoder.classes_)).to(device)
optimizer = AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-5, weight_decay=0.01)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()

# Training loop with early stopping
best_score = 0
epochs_no_improve = 0
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for batch in train_loader:
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items() if k != "targets"}
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        loss = criterion(outputs, batch["targets"].to(device))
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_preds, val_targets = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items() if k != "targets"}
            preds = model(**inputs).cpu().numpy()
            val_preds.append(preds)
            val_targets.append(batch["targets"].numpy())

    val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds)
    val_targets = np.concatenate(val_targets)
    correlations = []
    for i in range(30):
        corr = spearmanr(val_preds[:, i], val_targets[:, i]).correlation
        correlations.append(0 if np.isnan(corr) else corr)
    mean_corr = np.mean(correlations)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1} Validation Spearman: {mean_corr:.4f}")

    if mean_corr > best_score:
        best_score = mean_corr
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

# Generate predictions
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pt"))
model.eval()
test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items()}
        preds = model(**inputs).cpu().numpy()
        test_preds.append(preds)

submission = pd.DataFrame(np.concatenate(test_preds), columns=target_cols)
submission.insert(0, "qa_id", test_df["qa_id"].values)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Final Validation Score: {best_score:.4f}")

    pred_std = torch.sqrt((preds_centered**2).mean(dim=0) + 1e-6)
    target_std = torch.sqrt((targets_centered**2).mean(dim=0) + 1e-6)
    pearson = covariance / (pred_std * target_std)
    return -pearson.mean()

    truths = torch.cat(truths).numpy()
    scores = [spearmanr(truths[:, i], preds[:, i]).correlation for i in range(30)]
    mean_score = np.nanmean(scores)

            torch.nn.Linear(768 * 2 + 768, 1536),

        meta_proj = self.meta_proj(meta)

        combined = torch.cat([q_pooled, a_pooled, meta_proj], dim=1)
        return self.head(self.dropout(combined))

    targets_centered = targets - targets.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)
    covariance = (preds_centered * targets_centered).mean(dim=0)
    pred_std = torch.sqrt((preds_centered**2).mean(dim=0) + 1e-6)
    target_std = torch.sqrt((targets_centered**2).mean(dim=0) + 1e-6)
    pearson = covariance / (pred_std * target_std)
    return -pearson.mean()

# Hybrid loss function combining MSE and Pearson correlation
class HybridLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha  # Weighting between MSE and Pearson

    def pearson_loss(self, y_pred, y_true):
        y_pred = (y_pred - y_pred.mean()) / (y_pred.std() + 1e-7)
        y_true = (y_true - y_true.mean()) / (y_true.std() + 1e-7)
        return 0.5 * (1 - F.cosine_similarity(y_pred, y_true, dim=-1).mean())

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        mse = F.mse_loss(y_pred, y_true)
        pearson = self.pearson_loss(y_pred, y_true)
        return self.alpha * mse + (1 - self.alpha) * pearson

class QADataset(Dataset):

        self.meta_features = meta_features
        self.targets = targets

        )

class CrossEncoderRegressor(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_categories, num_hosts):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-base")
        self.category_embed = torch.nn.Embedding(num_categories, 64)
        self.host_embed = torch.nn.Embedding(num_hosts, 64)
        self.meta_proj = torch.nn.Sequential(
            torch.nn.Linear(128, 512),
            torch.nn.ReLU(),
            torch.nn.Linear(512, 768),
        )
        self.head = torch.nn.Sequential(
            torch.nn.Linear(768 * 2, 1536),
            torch.nn.GELU(),
            torch.nn.Dropout(0.3),
            torch.nn.Linear(1536, 30),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, meta):
        outputs = self.encoder(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        text_embed = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]

        # Extract and embed categorical features
        categories = meta[:, 0]
        hosts = meta[:, 1]
        cat_emb = self.category_embed(categories)
        host_emb = self.host_embed(hosts)
        meta_emb = torch.cat([cat_emb, host_emb], dim=1)
        meta_projected = self.meta_proj(meta_emb)

        combined = torch.cat([text_embed, meta_projected], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined)


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = CrossEncoderRegressor(num_categories, num_hosts).to(device)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=5)


def spearman_loss(preds, targets):
    preds_rank = torch.argsort(preds, dim=0)
    targets_rank = torch.argsort(targets, dim=0)
    return torch.mean((preds_rank - targets_rank).float() ** 2)


best_score = -1
patience = 2
current_patience = 0

for epoch in range(15):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0
    for batch in train_loader:
        inputs, meta, targets = batch
        input_ids = inputs["input_ids"].to(device)
        attention_mask = inputs["attention_mask"].to(device)
        meta, targets = meta.to(device), targets.to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(input_ids, attention_mask, meta)
        preds = torch.sigmoid(outputs)

        loss = 0.5 * spearman_loss(preds, targets) + 0.5 * torch.nn.functional.mse_loss(
            preds, targets
        )
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()

    scheduler.step()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    preds, truths = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            inputs, meta, targets = batch
            input_ids = inputs["input_ids"].to(device)
            attention_mask = inputs["attention_mask"].to(device)
            meta = meta.to(device)

            outputs = model(input_ids, attention_mask, meta)
            preds.append(torch.sigmoid(outputs).cpu())
            truths.append(targets.cpu())

    preds = torch.cat(preds).numpy()
    truths = torch.cat(truths).numpy()
    scores = [spearmanr(truths[:, i], preds[:, i]).correlation for i in range(30)]
    mean_score = np.nanmean(scores)
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Loss={total_loss/len(train_loader):.4f}, Val Score={mean_score:.4f}"
    )

    if mean_score > best_score:
        best_score = mean_score
        current_patience = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pt")
    else:
        current_patience += 1
        if current_patience >= patience:
            print("Early stopping")
            break

# Generate submission
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pt", map_location=device))
model.eval()
test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:

# Hybrid loss function combining MSE and Pearson correlation
class HybridLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha  # Weighting between MSE and Pearson

    def pearson_loss(self, y_pred, y_true):
        y_pred = (y_pred - y_pred.mean()) / (y_pred.std() + 1e-7)
        y_true = (y_true - y_true.mean()) / (y_true.std() + 1e-7)
        return 0.5 * (1 - F.cosine_similarity(y_pred, y_true, dim=-1).mean())

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        mse = F.mse_loss(y_pred, y_true)
        pearson = self.pearson_loss(y_pred, y_true)
        return self.alpha * mse + (1 - self.alpha) * pearson

# Dual-encoder model architecture
class DualDeBERTa(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.question_encoder = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")
        self.answer_encoder = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")
        self.host_embed = nn.Embedding(len(hosts) + 1, 32)
        self.category_embed = nn.Embedding(len(categories) + 1, 32)

        combined_size = (
            self.question_encoder.config.hidden_size
            + self.answer_encoder.config.hidden_size
            + 64
        )

        self.regressor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(combined_size, 1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(512, 30),
        )

    def forward(
        self, input_ids, attention_mask, token_type_ids, host_idx, category_idx
    ):
        # Separate question and answer using token_type_ids
        question_mask = token_type_ids == 0
        answer_mask = token_type_ids == 1

        question_outputs = self.question_encoder(
            input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask * question_mask
        )
        answer_outputs = self.answer_encoder(
            input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask * answer_mask
        )

        question_rep = question_outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0]
        answer_rep = answer_outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0]
        host_emb = self.host_embed(host_idx)
        cat_emb = self.category_embed(category_idx)

        combined = torch.cat([question_rep, answer_rep, host_emb, cat_emb], dim=1)
        return self.regressor(combined)

class AttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size):
        super().__init__()
        self.attn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 256), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(256, 1), nn.Softmax(dim=1)
        )
        self.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)

    def forward(self, hidden_states, mask=None):
        hidden_states = self.layer_norm(hidden_states)
        attn_scores = self.attn(hidden_states)
        if mask is not None:
            attn_scores = attn_scores.masked_fill(mask.unsqueeze(-1) == 0, -1e9)
            attn_scores = F.softmax(attn_scores, dim=1)
        return torch.sum(hidden_states * attn_scores, dim=1)


class DualDeBERTa(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.question_encoder = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")
        self.answer_encoder = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")
        self.question_attn = AttentionPooling(self.question_encoder.config.hidden_size)
        self.answer_attn = AttentionPooling(self.answer_encoder.config.hidden_size)
        self.host_embed = nn.Embedding(len(hosts) + 1, 64)
        self.category_embed = nn.Embedding(len(categories) + 1, 64)

        combined_size = self.question_encoder.config.hidden_size * 2 + 128

        self.regressor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(combined_size, 1536),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.LayerNorm(1536),
            nn.Linear(1536, 768),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(768, 30),
        )

    def forward(
        self, input_ids, attention_mask, token_type_ids, host_idx, category_idx
    ):
        question_mask = (token_type_ids == 0) * attention_mask
        answer_mask = (token_type_ids == 1) * attention_mask

        question_outputs = self.question_encoder(
            input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=question_mask
        )
        answer_outputs = self.answer_encoder(
            input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=answer_mask
        )

        question_rep = self.question_attn(
            question_outputs.last_hidden_state, question_mask
        )
        answer_rep = self.answer_attn(answer_outputs.last_hidden_state, answer_mask)
        host_emb = self.host_embed(host_idx)
        cat_emb = self.category_embed(category_idx)

        combined = torch.cat([question_rep, answer_rep, host_emb, cat_emb], dim=1)
        return self.regressor(combined)

# Enhanced loss with label smoothing
class EnhancedLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.7, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def pearson_loss(self, y_pred, y_true):
        y_pred = (y_pred - y_pred.mean()) / (y_pred.std() + 1e-7)
        y_true = (y_true - y_true.mean()) / (y_true.std() + 1e-7)
        return 0.5 * (1 - F.cosine_similarity(y_pred, y_true, dim=-1).mean())

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        # Apply label smoothing
        y_true = y_true * (1 - self.smoothing) + 0.5 * self.smoothing
        mse = F.mse_loss(y_pred, y_true)
        pearson = self.pearson_loss(y_pred, y_true)
        return self.alpha * mse + (1 - self.alpha) * pearson

class CrossEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.transformer = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")
        self.transformer.resize_token_embeddings(len(tokenizer))

        # Attention pooling
        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.transformer.config.hidden_size, 512),
            nn.Tanh(),
            nn.Linear(512, 1, bias=False),
        )

        # Label correlation layer
        self.label_corr = nn.Linear(30, 30, bias=False)
        nn.init.eye_(self.label_corr.weight)

        # Feature integration
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.transformer.config.hidden_size + 64, 1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            self.label_corr,
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

        # Feature embeddings
        self.host_embed = nn.Embedding(len(hosts) + 1, 32)
        self.category_embed = nn.Embedding(len(categories) + 1, 32)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, host_idx, category_idx):
        outputs = self.transformer(input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)

        # Attention pooling
        weights = self.attention(outputs.last_hidden_state)
        weights = F.softmax(weights, dim=1)
        pooled = torch.sum(weights * outputs.last_hidden_state, dim=1)

        # Combine features
        host_emb = self.host_embed(host_idx)
        cat_emb = self.category_embed(category_idx)
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, host_emb, cat_emb], dim=1)

        return self.fc(combined)

class CorrelationLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha  # Weighting between MSE and correlation loss
        self.mse = nn.MSELoss()

    def forward(self, preds, targets):
        mse_loss = self.mse(preds, targets)

        # Pearson correlation calculation
        preds_centered = preds - preds.mean(dim=0)
        targets_centered = targets - targets.mean(dim=0)
        cov = (preds_centered * targets_centered).mean(dim=0)
        preds_std = preds_centered.std(dim=0) + 1e-8
        targets_std = targets_centered.std(dim=0) + 1e-8
        pearson = cov / (preds_std * targets_std)
        correlation_loss = 1 - pearson.mean()

        return self.alpha * mse_loss + (1 - self.alpha) * correlation_loss


class SiameseQA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name, num_cats, num_hosts, emb_dim=16):
        super().__init__()
        self.bert = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, emb_dim)

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.bert.config.hidden_size * 2 + emb_dim * 2, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(256, 30),
        )

        host_emb = self.host_emb(host)
        combined = torch.cat([q_out, a_out, cat_emb, host_emb], dim=1)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.head(combined))

class EnhancedLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.7, smoothing=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.smoothing = smoothing

    def pearson_loss(self, y_pred, y_true):
        y_pred = (y_pred - y_pred.mean()) / (y_pred.std() + 1e-7)
        y_true = (y_true - y_true.mean()) / (y_true.std() + 1e-7)
        return 0.5 * (1 - F.cosine_similarity(y_pred, y_true, dim=-1).mean())

    def forward(self, y_pred, y_true):
        y_true = y_true * (1 - self.smoothing) + 0.5 * self.smoothing
        mse = F.mse_loss(y_pred, y_true)
        pearson = self.pearson_loss(y_pred, y_true)
        return self.alpha * mse + (1 - self.alpha) * pearson

class FixedCrossEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.transformer = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")
        self.transformer.resize_token_embeddings(len(tokenizer))

        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.transformer.config.hidden_size, 512),
            nn.Tanh(),
            nn.Linear(512, 1, bias=False),
        )

        self.label_corr = nn.Linear(30, 30, bias=False)
        nn.init.eye_(self.label_corr.weight)

        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024 + 64, 1024),  # 1024 (DeBERTa) + 32+32 (embeddings)
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(512, 30),  # Critical fix: reduce to 30 before label_corr
            self.label_corr,
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

        self.host_embed = nn.Embedding(len(hosts) + 1, 32)
        self.category_embed = nn.Embedding(len(categories) + 1, 32)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, host_idx, category_idx):
        outputs = self.transformer(input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        weights = self.attention(outputs.last_hidden_state)
        weights = F.softmax(weights, dim=1)
        pooled = torch.sum(weights * outputs.last_hidden_state, dim=1)

        host_emb = self.host_embed(host_idx)
        cat_emb = self.category_embed(category_idx)
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, host_emb, cat_emb], dim=1)

        return self.fc(combined)

        self.mse = nn.MSELoss()

        # Spearman approximation
        preds_rank = torch.argsort(torch.argsort(preds, dim=0), dim=0, descending=True)

            torch.argsort(targets, dim=0), dim=0, descending=True

        rank_cov = torch.cov(preds_rank - targets_rank).diag().mean()
        rank_loss = (
            1
            - (
                rank_cov / (preds_rank.std(dim=0) * targets_rank.std(dim=0) + 1e-8)

        )

        return self.alpha * mse_loss + (1 - self.alpha) * rank_loss

        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 8)

        cat_emb = self.cat_emb(cat)
        host_emb = self.host_emb(host)
        combined = torch.cat([text_out, cat_emb, host_emb], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(self.drop(combined))

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel, AdamW
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
import os

# Preprocess data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Encode categorical features
host_encoder = LabelEncoder()
host_encoder.fit(train_df["host"])
train_df["host"] = host_encoder.transform(train_df["host"])
test_df["host"] = host_encoder.transform(
    test_df["host"].apply(lambda x: x if x in host_encoder.classes_ else "unknown")
)

category_encoder = LabelEncoder()
category_encoder.fit(train_df["category"])
train_df["category"] = category_encoder.transform(train_df["category"])
test_df["category"] = category_encoder.transform(
    test_df["category"].apply(

    )
)

target_columns = train_df.columns[-30:].tolist()

MAX_LEN = 512
BATCH_SIZE = 8
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")


class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, is_test=False):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.is_test = is_test
        if not self.is_test:
            self.targets = self.df[target_columns].values.astype(np.float32)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        text = f"{row['question_title']} [SEP] {row['question_body']} [SEP] {row['answer']}"
        inputs = tokenizer.encode_plus(
            text,
            None,
            add_special_tokens=True,
            max_length=MAX_LEN,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            return_token_type_ids=False,
        )

        item = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(inputs["input_ids"], dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(inputs["attention_mask"], dtype=torch.long),
            "host": torch.tensor(row["host"], dtype=torch.long),
            "category": torch.tensor(row["category"], dtype=torch.long),
        }

        if not self.is_test:
            item["targets"] = torch.tensor(self.targets[idx], dtype=torch.float)

        return item


class QAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.deberta = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(len(host_encoder.classes_) + 1, 64)
        self.category_emb = nn.Embedding(len(category_encoder.classes_) + 1, 64)
        self.regressor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024 + 128, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(512, 30),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, host, category):
        outputs = self.deberta(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        pooled = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0]
        host_emb = self.host_emb(host)
        cat_emb = self.category_emb(category)
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, host_emb, cat_emb], dim=1)
        return self.regressor(combined)


def compute_spearman(preds, targets):
    corr_coeffs = []
    for i in range(preds.shape[1]):
        corr, _ = spearmanr(preds[:, i], targets[:, i])
        corr_coeffs.append(corr)
    return np.nanmean(corr_coeffs)

class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, tokenizer, max_len=512, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_len = max_len
        self.q_max_len = max_len // 2
        self.a_max_len = max_len - max_len // 2
        self.is_test = is_test

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        question = row["question_title"] + " " + row["question_body"]
        answer = row["answer"]

        q_enc = self.tokenizer(
            question,
            max_length=self.q_max_len,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        a_enc = self.tokenizer(
            answer,
            max_length=self.a_max_len,
            truncation=True,
            padding="max_length",
            return_tensors="pt",
        )

        item = {
            "q_input_ids": q_enc["input_ids"].squeeze(),
            "q_attention_mask": q_enc["attention_mask"].squeeze(),
            "a_input_ids": a_enc["input_ids"].squeeze(),

class CorrelationLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.5):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.mse = nn.MSELoss()

    def forward(self, preds, targets):
        mse_loss = self.mse(preds, targets)

        preds_centered = preds - preds.mean(dim=0)
        targets_centered = targets - targets.mean(dim=0)
        cov = (preds_centered * targets_centered).mean(dim=0)
        preds_std = preds_centered.std(dim=0) + 1e-8
        targets_std = targets_centered.std(dim=0) + 1e-8
        pearson = cov / (preds_std * targets_std)
        correlation_loss = 1 - pearson.mean()

        return self.alpha * mse_loss + (1 - self.alpha) * correlation_loss


class DualEncoderQA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name, num_cats, num_hosts, emb_dim=64):
        super().__init__()
        self.q_encoder = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.a_encoder = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, emb_dim)
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(num_hosts, emb_dim)

        # Feature transformation layers
        self.q_transform = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(768, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.LayerNorm(256)
        )
        self.a_transform = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(768, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.LayerNorm(256)
        )
        self.meta_transform = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(emb_dim * 2, 128), nn.ReLU(), nn.LayerNorm(128)
        )

        # Combined prediction head
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256 + 256 + 128, 512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(256, 30),
        )

    def forward(
        self, q_input_ids, q_attention_mask, a_input_ids, a_attention_mask, cat, host
    ):
        q_outputs = self.q_encoder(
            input_ids=q_input_ids, attention_mask=q_attention_mask
        ).last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]

        a_outputs = self.a_encoder(
            input_ids=a_input_ids, attention_mask=a_attention_mask
        ).last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]

        q_features = self.q_transform(q_outputs)
        a_features = self.a_transform(a_outputs)

        meta = torch.cat([self.cat_emb(cat), self.host_emb(host)], dim=1)
        meta_features = self.meta_transform(meta)

        combined = torch.cat([q_features, a_features, meta_features], dim=1)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.head(combined))

        fused_features = gate * text_features + (1 - gate) * projected_emb

from scipy.stats import spearmanr

from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# Configuration
MODEL_NAME = "bert-large-uncased"  # Changed to BERT for token type embeddings
MAX_LEN = 512
BATCH_SIZE = 16
EPOCHS = 10
PATIENCE = 2

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
target_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in test_df.columns]

# Prepare text inputs
train_df["question_text"] = (
    train_df["question_title"].fillna("") + " " + train_df["question_body"].fillna("")
)
train_df["answer_text"] = train_df["answer"].fillna("")
test_df["question_text"] = (
    test_df["question_title"].fillna("") + " " + test_df["question_body"].fillna("")
)
test_df["answer_text"] = test_df["answer"].fillna("")

# Encode categorical features
combined_cats = pd.concat([train_df["category"], test_df["category"]])
category_encoder = LabelEncoder().fit(combined_cats)
train_df["category_encoded"] = category_encoder.transform(train_df["category"])
test_df["category_encoded"] = category_encoder.transform(test_df["category"])

combined_hosts = pd.concat([train_df["host"], test_df["host"]])
host_encoder = LabelEncoder().fit(combined_hosts)
train_df["host_encoded"] = host_encoder.transform(train_df["host"])
test_df["host_encoded"] = host_encoder.transform(test_df["host"])

# Train-validation split
train_df, val_df = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

# Tokenization
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)


class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, questions, answers, categories, hosts, targets=None):
        self.questions = questions
        self.answers = answers
        self.categories = categories
        self.hosts = hosts
        self.targets = targets

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.questions)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        encoding = tokenizer(
            text=str(self.questions[idx]),
            text_pair=str(self.answers[idx]),
            add_special_tokens=True,
            max_length=MAX_LEN,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            return_tensors="pt",
            return_token_type_ids=True,  # Added for BERT token types
        )

        item = {
            "input_ids": encoding["input_ids"].squeeze(),
            "attention_mask": encoding["attention_mask"].squeeze(),
            "token_type_ids": encoding["token_type_ids"].squeeze(),  # Added
            "category": torch.tensor(self.categories[idx], dtype=torch.long),
            "host": torch.tensor(self.hosts[idx], dtype=torch.long),
        }

        if self.targets is not None:
            item["targets"] = torch.tensor(self.targets[idx], dtype=torch.float)
        return item


# Create datasets
train_dataset = QADataset(
    train_df["question_text"].values,
    train_df["answer_text"].values,
    train_df["category_encoded"].values,
    train_df["host_encoded"].values,
    train_df[target_cols].values,
)

)

    test_df["category_encoded"].values,
    test_df["host_encoded"].values,
)

)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=4)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, num_workers=4)


class QAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_cats, num_hosts):
        super().__init__()
        self.transformer = AutoModel.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 32)  # Increased embedding size
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(num_hosts, 32)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.transformer.config.hidden_size + 64, 1024),  # Wider layers
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.Linear(512, 30),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, token_type_ids, category, host):
        outputs = self.transformer(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            token_type_ids=token_type_ids,  # Added token type IDs
        )
        cls_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0]
        cat_emb = self.cat_emb(category)
        host_emb = self.host_emb(host)
        combined = torch.cat([cls_output, cat_emb, host_emb], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined)

optimizer = AdamW(
    model.parameters(), lr=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01
)  # Adjusted learning rate
criterion = nn.MSELoss()

best_score = 0
epochs_no_improve = 0
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for batch in train_loader:
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items() if k != "targets"}
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        loss = criterion(outputs, batch["targets"].to(device))
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)

    model.eval()
    val_preds, val_targets = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items() if k != "targets"}
            preds = model(**inputs).cpu().numpy()
            val_preds.append(preds)

    correlations = []
    for i in range(30):
        corr = spearmanr(val_preds[:, i], val_targets[:, i]).correlation
        correlations.append(0 if np.isnan(corr) else corr)
    mean_corr = np.mean(correlations)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1} Validation Spearman: {mean_corr:.4f}")

    if mean_corr > best_score:
        best_score = mean_corr
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")

        gate_input = torch.cat([text_features, combined_emb], dim=1)
        gate = self.gate_act(self.gate_proj(gate_input))
        fused_features = gate * text_features + (1 - gate) * projected_emb

        return self.sigmoid(self.head(fused_features))

    def __init__(self, num_categories, num_hosts):

        # Fix dimension mismatch: text_features (1024) + combined_emb (128) = 1152
        self.gate_proj = torch.nn.Linear(1024 + 128, 1024)

            torch.nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            torch.nn.GELU(),
            torch.nn.Dropout(0.3),
            torch.nn.Linear(512, 30),

        host_emb = self.host_embed(host_idx)
        combined_emb = torch.cat([cat_emb, host_emb], dim=1)

        projected_emb = self.feature_proj(combined_emb)
        gate_input = torch.cat([text_features, combined_emb], dim=1)
        gate = self.gate_act(self.gate_proj(gate_input))
        fused_features = gate * text_features + (1 - gate) * projected_emb

        return self.sigmoid(self.head(fused_features))

            max_length=MAX_LEN,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )

        return {
            "q_input_ids": question_enc["input_ids"].squeeze(),
            "q_attn_mask": question_enc["attention_mask"].squeeze(),
            "a_input_ids": answer_enc["input_ids"].squeeze(),
            "a_attn_mask": answer_enc["attention_mask"].squeeze(),
            "category": torch.tensor(self.categories[idx], dtype=torch.long),

                torch.tensor(self.targets[idx], dtype=torch.float)
                if self.targets is not None
                else None
            ),

# Create datasets
def create_dataloader(df, targets=None, shuffle=False):
    dataset = QADataset(
        df["question_text"].values,
        df["answer"].values,
        df["category_encoded"].values,
        df["host_encoded"].values,
        df["question_user_freq"].values,
        df["answer_user_freq"].values,
        targets=df[target_cols].values if targets else None,
    )
    return DataLoader(
        dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=shuffle, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
    )

class DualEncoderModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_cats, num_hosts):
        super().__init__()
        self.transformer = AutoModel.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 32)
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(num_hosts, 32)

            nn.Linear(self.transformer.config.hidden_size * 2 + 32 * 2 + 2, 1024),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.Linear(512, 30),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(
        self,
        q_input_ids,
        q_attn_mask,
        a_input_ids,
        a_attn_mask,
        category,
        host,
        user_freq_q,
        user_freq_a,
    ):

        q_outputs = self.transformer(input_ids=q_input_ids, attention_mask=q_attn_mask)
        q_cls = q_outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0]

        # Process answer
        a_outputs = self.transformer(input_ids=a_input_ids, attention_mask=a_attn_mask)
        a_cls = a_outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0]

        # Combine features
        cat_emb = self.cat_emb(category)
        host_emb = self.host_emb(host)
        combined = torch.cat(
            [
                q_cls,
                a_cls,
                cat_emb,
                host_emb,
                user_freq_q.unsqueeze(1),
                user_freq_a.unsqueeze(1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )

        return self.head(combined)

with torch.no_grad():

def pearson_loss(output, target):
    x = output - output.mean(dim=0)
    y = target - target.mean(dim=0)
    cov = (x * y).mean(dim=0)
    x_std = torch.std(x, dim=0, unbiased=False)
    y_std = torch.std(y, dim=0, unbiased=False)
    pearson = cov / (x_std * y_std + 1e-6)
    return 1 - pearson.mean()

class DualEncoderModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_cats, num_hosts):
        super().__init__()
        config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
        config.gradient_checkpointing = True
        self.transformer = AutoModel.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME, config=config)
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 64)
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(num_hosts, 64)
        hidden_size = self.transformer.config.hidden_size

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size * 2 + 64 * 2 + 2, 1536),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.LayerNorm(1536),
            nn.Linear(1536, 768),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.LayerNorm(768),
            nn.Linear(768, 30),

        )

        self,
        input_ids_question,
        attention_mask_question,
        input_ids_answer,
        attention_mask_answer,
        category,
        host,
        user_freq_q,
        user_freq_a,
    ):
        # Process question and answer through shared encoder
        question_outputs = self.transformer(
            input_ids=input_ids_question, attention_mask=attention_mask_question
        )
        answer_outputs = self.transformer(
            input_ids=input_ids_answer, attention_mask=attention_mask_answer
        )

        # Extract CLS embeddings
        question_cls = question_outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0]
        answer_cls = answer_outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0]

        # Embed categorical features
        cat_emb = self.cat_emb(category)
        host_emb = self.host_emb(host)

        # Combine all features
        combined = torch.cat(
            [
                question_cls,
                answer_cls,
                cat_emb,
                host_emb,
                user_freq_q.unsqueeze(1),
                user_freq_a.unsqueeze(1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )

        return self.head(combined)

            "user_freq_a": batch["user_freq_a"].to(device),
        }

        with autocast():
            outputs = model(**inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, batch["targets"].to(device))

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()

    # Validation
    model.eval()
    val_preds, val_targets = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            inputs = {
                "input_ids_question": batch["input_ids_question"].to(device),

            }

            preds = model(**inputs).cpu().numpy()
            val_preds.append(preds)
            val_targets.append(batch["targets"].numpy())

    val_targets = np.concatenate(val_targets)
    correlations = [

    ]
    mean_corr = np.nanmean(correlations)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1} Validation Spearman: {mean_corr:.4f}")

    # Early stopping
    if mean_corr > best_score:
        best_score = mean_corr
        epochs_no_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pt")
    else:
        epochs_no_improve += 1
        if epochs_no_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

# Generate final predictions
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pt"))
model.eval()
test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():

from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModel
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

# Load and preprocess data
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

train_df["full_text"] = (
    train_df["question_title"]
    + " "
    + train_df["question_body"]
    + " "
    + train_df["answer"]
)
test_df["full_text"] = (
    test_df["question_title"] + " " + test_df["question_body"] + " " + test_df["answer"]
)

# Encode categorical features
cat_encoder = LabelEncoder()
host_encoder = LabelEncoder()
train_df["category"] = cat_encoder.fit_transform(train_df["category"])
train_df["host"] = host_encoder.fit_transform(train_df["host"])
test_df["category"] = cat_encoder.transform(test_df["category"])
test_df["host"] = host_encoder.transform(test_df["host"])

# Prepare targets and split data
target_cols = [col for col in train_df if col.startswith(("question_", "answer_"))]
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df[["full_text", "category", "host"]],
    train_df[target_cols],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
)

# Dataset and tokenizer
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")


class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, cats, hosts, targets=None):
        self.texts = texts
        self.cats = cats
        self.hosts = hosts
        self.targets = targets

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        inputs = tokenizer(
            self.texts.iloc[idx],
            max_length=512,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        data = {
            "input_ids": inputs["input_ids"].squeeze(),
            "attention_mask": inputs["attention_mask"].squeeze(),
            "cat": torch.tensor(self.cats.iloc[idx]),
            "host": torch.tensor(self.hosts.iloc[idx]),
        }
        if self.targets is not None:
            data["targets"] = torch.FloatTensor(self.targets.iloc[idx])
        return data


train_ds = QADataset(
    X_train["full_text"], X_train["category"], X_train["host"], y_train
)

# Model architecture
class BERTRegressor(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_cats, num_hosts):
        super().__init__()
        self.bert = AutoModel.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 32)
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(num_hosts, 32)
        self.regressor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(768 + 64, 512), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(0.2), nn.Linear(512, 30)
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, cat, host):
        outputs = self.bert(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        text_feat = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]
        cat_feat = self.cat_emb(cat)
        host_feat = self.host_emb(host)
        combined = torch.cat([text_feat, cat_feat, host_feat], dim=1)
        return self.regressor(combined)


# Training setup
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = BERTRegressor(len(cat_encoder.classes_), len(host_encoder.classes_)).to(device)

    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in val_loader:
            inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items() if k != "targets"}
            out = model(**inputs).sigmoid()
            preds.append(out.cpu())
            truths.append(batch["targets"])
    preds = torch.cat(preds).numpy()
    truths = torch.cat(truths).numpy()
    return np.mean(
        [spearmanr(preds[:, i], truths[:, i]).correlation for i in range(30)]
    )

        outputs = model(**inputs)
        loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

    val_score = validate()
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Val Score {val_score:.4f}")
    if val_score > best_score:
        best_score = val_score
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pt")

# Generate submission
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pt"))
model.eval()
preds = []
with torch.no_grad():

        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 128)

            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.LayerNorm(384),
            nn.Linear(384, 30),

        cat_emb = self.cat_emb(batch["category"])
        host_emb = self.host_emb(batch["host"])

            [
                q_out,
                a_out,
                cat_emb,
                host_emb,
                batch["user_freq_q"].unsqueeze(1),
                batch["user_freq_a"].unsqueeze(1),
            ],
            dim=1,
        )

test_df["question_text"] = test_df["question_title"] + " " + test_df["question_body"]

        padding="max_length",
        truncation=True,
        max_length=max_length,

# Dataset preparation
class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, encodings, categories, hosts, labels=None):
        self.encodings = encodings
        self.categories = categories
        self.hosts = hosts
        self.labels = labels

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        item = {
            "input_ids": self.encodings["input_ids"][idx],
            "attention_mask": self.encodings["attention_mask"][idx],
            "category": self.categories[idx],
            "host": self.hosts[idx],
        }
        if self.labels is not None:

class DeBERTaRegressor(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_cats, num_hosts):
        super().__init__()
        self.deberta = DebertaModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-base")
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 32)
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(num_hosts, 32)
        self.regressor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.deberta.config.hidden_size + 64, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(256, 30),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, category, host):
        outputs = self.deberta(input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        pooled = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0]
        cat_emb = self.cat_emb(category)
        host_emb = self.host_emb(host)
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, cat_emb, host_emb], dim=1)
        return self.regressor(combined)

    val_preds = np.concatenate(val_preds)
    val_targets = np.concatenate(val_targets)
    spearman_scores = [
        spearmanr(val_preds[:, i], val_targets[:, i]).correlation for i in range(30)
    ]
    mean_score = np.nanmean(spearman_scores)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Validation Spearman = {mean_score:.4f}")

# Generate predictions
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=16, shuffle=False, num_workers=4)
model.eval()
test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:

        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(device)
        category = batch["category"].to(device)
        host = batch["host"].to(device)

        outputs = model(input_ids, attention_mask, category, host)
        test_preds.append(outputs.cpu().numpy())

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(np.concatenate(test_preds), columns=target_cols)
submission.insert(0, "qa_id", test_df["qa_id"])
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
