        return item


class EnhancedCorrelationLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.reg_loss = nn.SmoothL1Loss()
        self.rank_loss = nn.MSELoss()

    def forward(self, preds, targets):
        regression_loss = self.reg_loss(preds, targets)

        # Compute rank-based loss
        pred_ranks = torch.argsort(torch.argsort(preds, dim=0), dim=0).float()
        target_ranks = torch.argsort(torch.argsort(targets, dim=0), dim=0).float()
        rank_loss = self.rank_loss(pred_ranks, target_ranks)

        return self.alpha * regression_loss + (1 - self.alpha) * rank_loss


class EnhancedQA(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name, num_cats, num_hosts):
        super().__init__()
        self.transformer = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 128)
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(num_hosts, 128)

        self.meta_processor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 512), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(512), nn.Dropout(0.3)
        )

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.transformer.config.hidden_size + 512, 768),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.LayerNorm(768),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(768, 384),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.LayerNorm(384),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(384, 30),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, cat, host):
        outputs = self.transformer(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        cls_output = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]

        meta = torch.cat([self.cat_emb(cat), self.host_emb(host)], dim=1)
        meta = self.meta_processor(meta)

        combined = torch.cat([cls_output, meta], dim=1)
        return torch.sigmoid(self.head(combined))

def add_agg_features(df, host_df, category_df, train_ref):
    host_feats = pd.merge(df[["host"]], host_df, on="host", how="left").drop(
        columns="host"
    )
    host_feats = host_feats.fillna(train_ref[target_cols].mean())

    )

    return pd.concat(

    )

class DebertaAggModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.transformer = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-base")
        self.agg_proj = nn.Linear(60, 60 * 768)
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=768, num_heads=8, batch_first=True
        )
        self.regressor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(768 * 2, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(256, 30),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, agg):
        outputs = self.transformer(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        cls = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0]

        agg_proj = self.agg_proj(agg).view(agg.size(0), 60, 768)
        query = cls.unsqueeze(1)
        attn_output, _ = self.attention(query, agg_proj, agg_proj)
        attn_output = attn_output.squeeze(1)

        combined = torch.cat([cls, attn_output], dim=1)
        return self.regressor(combined)

        self.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("roberta-base")

            self.texts[idx],

        )

        return item

        super().__init__()
        self.text_encoder = AutoModel.from_pretrained("roberta-base")
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 64)
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(num_hosts, 64)

        host_emb = self.host_emb(host)

        )

        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 64)

        cat_emb = self.cat_emb(category)
        host_emb = self.host_emb(host)
        combined = torch.cat([pooled, cat_emb, host_emb], dim=1)

# Dataset class with separate question/answer processing
class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, questions, answers, cats, hosts, targets=None):
        self.questions = questions.values
        self.answers = answers.values
        self.cats = cats.values
        self.hosts = hosts.values
        self.targets = targets.values if targets is not None else None
        self.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.questions)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        question_inputs = self.tokenizer(
            self.questions[idx],
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=256,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        answer_inputs = self.tokenizer(
            self.answers[idx],
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=256,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )

        item = {
            "q_input_ids": question_inputs["input_ids"].squeeze(),
            "q_attention_mask": question_inputs["attention_mask"].squeeze(),
            "a_input_ids": answer_inputs["input_ids"].squeeze(),
            "a_attention_mask": answer_inputs["attention_mask"].squeeze(),
            "cat": torch.tensor(self.cats[idx], dtype=torch.long),
            "host": torch.tensor(self.hosts[idx], dtype=torch.long),
        }
        if self.targets is not None:
            item["targets"] = torch.FloatTensor(self.targets[idx])
        return item


# Enhanced model architecture with dual text pathways
class QAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_cats, num_hosts):
        super().__init__()
        self.text_encoder = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 64)
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(num_hosts, 64)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024 * 2 + 128, 1024),  # Double text features from Q&A
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.Linear(512, 30),
        )

    def forward(
        self, q_input_ids, q_attention_mask, a_input_ids, a_attention_mask, cat, host
    ):
        # Process question
        q_outputs = self.text_encoder(
            input_ids=q_input_ids, attention_mask=q_attention_mask
        )
        q_features = torch.mean(q_outputs.last_hidden_state, dim=1)

        # Process answer
        a_outputs = self.text_encoder(
            input_ids=a_input_ids, attention_mask=a_attention_mask
        )
        a_features = torch.mean(a_outputs.last_hidden_state, dim=1)

        # Combine features
        combined = torch.cat(
            [q_features, a_features, self.cat_emb(cat), self.host_emb(host)], dim=1
        )

        return torch.sigmoid(self.head(combined))


# Training setup
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    num_cats=len(LabelEncoder().fit(train_df["category"]).classes_) + 1,

    )

    # Validation
    model.eval()

    )
    print(

    )

    if val_corr > best_score:

class PearsonLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

    def forward(self, preds, targets):
        preds_centered = preds - preds.mean(dim=0)
        targets_centered = targets - targets.mean(dim=0)
        cov = (preds_centered * targets_centered).sum(dim=0)
        preds_std = torch.sqrt((preds_centered**2).sum(dim=0) + 1e-6)
        targets_std = torch.sqrt((targets_centered**2).sum(dim=0) + 1e-6)
        pearson = cov / (preds_std * targets_std)
        return 1 - pearson.mean()

from scipy.stats import spearmanr

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Preprocess texts
train_df["question_text"] = train_df["question_title"] + " " + train_df["question_body"]

test_df["question_text"] = test_df["question_title"] + " " + test_df["question_body"]

    test_df[f"{col}_idx"] = le.transform(

# Enhanced dataset with combined question-answer processing
class QADataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, questions, answers, cats, hosts, targets=None):
        self.questions = questions.values
        self.answers = answers.values
        self.cats = cats.values
        self.hosts = hosts.values
        self.targets = targets.values if targets is not None else None
        self.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.questions)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        inputs = self.tokenizer(
            self.questions[idx],
            self.answers[idx],
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            max_length=512,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        item = {
            "input_ids": inputs["input_ids"].squeeze(),
            "attention_mask": inputs["attention_mask"].squeeze(),
            "cat": torch.tensor(self.cats[idx], dtype=torch.long),
            "host": torch.tensor(self.hosts[idx], dtype=torch.long),
        }
        if self.targets is not None:
            item["targets"] = torch.FloatTensor(self.targets[idx])
        return item


# Modified model architecture with combined processing
class QAModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_cats, num_hosts):
        super().__init__()
        self.text_encoder = AutoModel.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-large")
        self.cat_emb = nn.Embedding(num_cats, 64)
        self.host_emb = nn.Embedding(num_hosts, 64)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024 + 128, 1024),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.Linear(1024, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.Linear(512, 30),
        )

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, cat, host):
        outputs = self.text_encoder(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        cls_features = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0, :]  # CLS token
        combined = torch.cat(
            [cls_features, self.cat_emb(cat), self.host_emb(host)], dim=1
        )
        return torch.sigmoid(self.head(combined))


# Training setup

    num_cats=len(LabelEncoder().fit(train_df["category"]).classes_) + 1,
    num_hosts=len(LabelEncoder().fit(train_df["host"]).classes_) + 1,
